description: Source file implementing media utility functions and classes for the starboard media namespace, including stream info assignment, comparison operators, and helper functions for media data processing.

classes.name: AudioStreamInfo
classes.description: Represents audio stream information including codec, mime type, channels, sample rate, and configuration data.

classes.name: VideoStreamInfo
classes.description: Represents video stream information including codec, mime type, capabilities, resolution, and color metadata.

classes.name: AudioSampleInfo
classes.description: Contains information about audio samples, including stream info and discarded durations.

classes.name: VideoSampleInfo
classes.description: Contains information about video samples, including stream info and key frame status.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operators for copying stream info and sample info objects.

methods.name: ConvertTo
methods.description: Converts internal stream info representations to platform-specific structures.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison operators for stream info, sample info, and color metadata.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison operators for stream info, sample info, and color metadata.

methods.name: IsSDRVideo
methods.description: Determines if a video stream or mime type corresponds to SDR (standard dynamic range) video.

methods.name: GetBytesPerSample
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes per audio sample based on sample type.

methods.name: GetStringRepresentation
methods.description: Returns a string representation of binary data, printing printable characters and replacing others with '?'.

methods.name: GetMixedRepresentation
methods.description: Returns a hex and ASCII mixed string representation of binary data, formatted per line.

methods.name: IsAudioSampleInfoSubstantiallyDifferent
methods.description: Checks if two audio stream info objects differ significantly.

methods.name: AudioDurationToFrames
methods.description: Converts audio duration in microseconds to frame count based on sample rate.

methods.name: AudioFramesToDuration
methods.description: Converts frame count to duration in microseconds based on sample rate.
